regions.name: Bend left
regions.note: Ease off and steer gently left. Stay left of the centre of the road, and expect oncoming vehicles to cut the corner.

regions.name: Bend right
regions.note: Ease off and steer gently right. Hold your lane, and look out for oncoming vehicles and pedestrians on the bend.

regions.name: Successive bends to the left
regions.note: Slow down before the first bend, stay well inside your lane through each curve, and don't overtake.

regions.name: Successive bends to the right
regions.note: Slow down before the first bend, stay well inside your lane through each curve, and don't overtake.

regions.name: Steep descent ahead
regions.note: Shift to a lower gear before you start down. Don't keep your foot on the brake the whole way, stay in control, and leave room to the vehicle in front.

regions.name: Steep ascent ahead
regions.note: Shift to a lower gear to keep your power up, and expect slow vehicles ahead. Only overtake on the climb if you can see clearly.

regions.name: Road narrows ahead
regions.note: Slow down and be ready to give way to oncoming traffic. Don't try to overtake where the road gets narrow.

regions.name: Road narrows from right
regions.note: The right side of the road closes in. Slow down, keep left, and give way to oncoming traffic if you need to.

regions.name: Road narrows from left
regions.note: The left side of the road closes in. Slow down, keep right, and look out for pedestrians or obstacles on the left.

regions.name: River bank or quayside
regions.note: Slow right down and don't park close to the edge. The road may end suddenly at a bank or the water.

regions.name: Uneven road surface ahead
regions.note: Slow down so you stay in control, and grip the steering wheel firmly. Motorcyclists need extra care here.

regions.name: Severe bump ahead
regions.note: Slow down well before you reach the bump. Hitting it fast can damage your vehicle and make you lose control.

regions.name: Severe dip ahead
regions.note: Slow down. Taken too fast, your vehicle can hit the ground or leave it altogether. Water may also collect in the dip.

regions.name: River bend crossing (drift) ahead
regions.note: Slow down and check how deep the water is before you cross. Stay out if it's running fast or too deep to be safe.

regions.name: Slippery road
regions.note: Slow down straight away. No sudden braking, accelerating or sharp steering, and leave a bigger gap to the vehicle ahead.

regions.name: Loose surface road
regions.note: Slow down, because loose gravel can make you skid. Leave a bigger gap so stones thrown up don't cause damage.

regions.name: Danger of falling and fallen rocks ahead
regions.note: Drive carefully and look out for rocks on or beside the road. Don't stop or park below rocky slopes.

regions.name: Pedestrian crossing
regions.note: Slow down and get ready to stop. Give way to anyone on the crossing or about to step onto it.

regions.name: Children crossing ahead
regions.note: Slow right down and stay extra alert. Children can step out without warning, so be ready to stop at any moment.

regions.name: Cyclists
regions.note: Look out for cyclists on the road or joining it. Give them plenty of room when you overtake.

regions.name: Cattle crossing ahead
regions.note: Slow down and look out for animals on the road. You must stop if the person in charge of them signals you to, and wait until they've cleared.

regions.name: Wild animals
regions.note: Slow down and check the road edges for animals. Aggressive hooting can panic them into your path, so avoid it.

regions.name: Road works ahead
regions.note: Slow down and follow the temporary signs or flagmen. Expect changed lanes, rough surfaces and people working close to the road.

regions.name: Traffic light signals ahead
regions.note: Slow down, and get ready to stop and obey the lights. Don't speed up to beat them.

regions.name: Low-flying aircraft crossing ahead
regions.note: Aircraft may fly very low nearby, usually close to an airstrip, and the sudden noise can startle you. Keep a firm grip and stay in control.

regions.name: Two-way traffic ahead
regions.note: You're moving onto a road with traffic both ways. Keep left, look out for oncoming vehicles, and stay on your side of the centre line.

regions.name: Hazard ahead
regions.note: There's a danger ahead that the sign doesn't name. Slow down, stay alert and go carefully.

regions.name: Road junction ahead
regions.note: There's a junction coming up. Check your mirrors, slow down, and look out for vehicles coming in from side roads.

regions.name: Junction ahead: stop or give way
regions.note: Get ready to stop or give way at the junction ahead. Do what the sign there tells you.

regions.name: Junction ahead with road entering from right
regions.note: Another road joins from the right. Look out for vehicles merging, and be ready to change your speed or position.

regions.name: Junction ahead with acceleration lane from right
regions.note: Vehicles may join from an acceleration lane on the right. Hold a steady speed so they can merge safely.

regions.name: Roundabout ahead
regions.note: Slow down and give way to traffic already on the roundabout. Signal before you leave it.

regions.name: Rail crossing with barrier
regions.note: Stop when the barriers are down or the lights are flashing. Wait until the barriers are fully up and it's safe before you cross.

regions.name: Rail crossing without barrier
regions.note: Slow down, look both ways and listen for trains before you cross. Never try to beat a train to the crossing.

regions.name: Stop
regions.note: You MUST stop completely at the stop line. Slowing down is NOT enough. Look both ways, and only move off when the road is fully clear.

regions.name: Give way
regions.note: Slow down and let traffic on the major road go first. If the road is clear you don't have to stop, but you must always give others priority.

regions.name: Direction to be followed
regions.note: You must go the way the arrow points. No other direction is allowed here.

regions.name: Vehicles travel straight
regions.note: All vehicles must go straight on. You may not turn left or right here.

regions.name: Vehicles turn right junction
regions.note: All vehicles must turn right at this junction. Going straight on or turning left is not allowed.

regions.name: Vehicles travel straight or right
regions.note: You may only go straight on or turn right at this junction. Turning left is not allowed.

regions.name: Pass to the left
regions.note: Go past the obstacle or island on your left side. Never go to the right of this sign or island.

regions.name: Compulsory cycle track
regions.note: This track is for cyclists. Motor vehicles may not use it, except for access.

regions.name: Compulsory pedestrian foot path
regions.note: Pedestrians must walk on this path. Cyclists and motor vehicles must stay off it.

regions.name: Compulsory track for cattle
regions.note: Livestock must keep to this track. Drivers should slow down, since animals may be around.

regions.name: Compulsory minimum speed
regions.note: You must drive at the speed shown or faster. Going slower is not allowed. You'll mostly see this on highways and expressways.

regions.name: End of compulsory minimum speed
regions.note: The minimum speed ends here. Normal speed limits apply from now on.

regions.name: No entry
regions.note: You may not enter this road or area at all. You'll often see this at one-way streets and restricted zones.

regions.name: Road closed
regions.note: This road is closed to all traffic. Turn around and find another way, and don't go around the barriers.

regions.name: Entry forbidden to all vehicles
regions.note: No vehicle of any kind may go past here, with or without a motor.

regions.name: Entry forbidden to all motor cycles
regions.note: Motor cycles may not go past here. Riders must find another route.

regions.name: Entry forbidden to all bicycles
regions.note: Bicycles may not go past here. Cyclists must get off and find another route.

regions.name: No entry for pedestrians
regions.note: Pedestrians may not use this road or area. Find another route or crossing on foot.

regions.name: No entry for animal drawn vehicles
regions.note: Carts, wagons and other vehicles pulled by animals are not allowed. Find another route.

regions.name: No entry to all hand carts
regions.note: Hand-pushed carts, trolleys and barrows may not go past here.

regions.name: No entry for farm vehicles
regions.note: Farm vehicles such as tractors are not allowed. Use the routes set aside for them.

regions.name: No entry for heavy commercial vehicles
regions.note: Trucks, lorries and other heavy goods vehicles are not allowed. Use the routes set aside for them.

regions.name: No entry for power driven vehicles
regions.note: No motorised vehicles are allowed. Non-motorised transport may be permitted.

regions.name: No entry for power driven or animal vehicles
regions.note: Vehicles with motors and vehicles pulled by animals are both banned. Access is for pedestrians or emergencies only.

regions.name: No entry for vehicles exceeding width shown
regions.note: If your vehicle is wider than the width shown, you can't go on. Find another route.

regions.name: No entry for vehicles exceeding height shown
regions.note: If your vehicle is taller than the height shown, don't go on. You could hit something overhead, such as a bridge.

regions.name: No entry for vehicles exceeding weight shown
regions.note: If your vehicle is heavier than the weight shown, you may not go on. You'll often see this near bridges with load limits.

regions.name: No entry for vehicles exceeding weight shown on one axle
regions.note: If any one axle carries more than the weight shown, don't go on. Overloading can damage roads and bridges.

regions.name: No entry for vehicles exceeding length shown
regions.note: If your vehicle, including any trailer, is longer than the length shown, you can't go on. Find a route that takes long vehicles.

regions.name: No entry: vehicles must keep minimum distance shown
regions.note: Keep at least the distance shown between you and the vehicle in front. You'll often see this in tunnels and on bridges.

regions.name: No left turn
regions.note: You may not turn left at this junction. Go straight on or turn right, where that's allowed.

regions.name: No right turn
regions.note: You may not turn right at this junction. Go straight on or turn left, where that's allowed.

regions.name: No U-turn
regions.note: You may not make a U-turn here. Turn around further on, somewhere safe and legal.

regions.name: Overtaking of four-wheeled vehicles prohibited
regions.note: You may not overtake cars or other four-wheeled vehicles here, usually because poor visibility or a narrow road makes it dangerous.

regions.name: Overtaking of goods vehicles prohibited
regions.note: You may not overtake trucks or lorries on this stretch. Stay behind goods vehicles until the ban ends.

regions.name: Speed limit
regions.note: Stay at or below the speed shown, in km/h, until you reach an end-of-limit sign.

regions.name: Sounding of horns or sirens prohibited
regions.note: Don't use your horn or any other audible warning here. You'll often see this near hospitals, schools and homes.

regions.name: Stop at control post
regions.note: You must stop at this control point, such as a checkpoint, toll gate or border post, and wait to be cleared before moving on.

regions.name: Stop: children school
regions.note: You must stop when children are crossing. You'll see this by school entrances with a crossing patrol or crossing zone.

regions.name: Priority for on-coming traffic
regions.note: Oncoming vehicles go first on this narrow stretch. Wait until the road is clear before you go through.

regions.name: End of all prohibitions
regions.note: Every earlier ban on moving vehicles ends here. Normal rules apply.

regions.name: End of speed limit
regions.note: The speed limit that applied here has ended. Normal limits for this type of road apply, unless another sign says otherwise.

regions.name: Parking prohibited
regions.note: You may not park here. Keep going and find somewhere legal to leave your vehicle.

regions.name: Parking or waiting prohibited
regions.note: You may not park or even stop for a moment here. Keep going and find somewhere legal to stop.

regions.name: No stopping zone
regions.note: You may not stop anywhere in the marked zone, for any reason, including to drop off passengers.

regions.name: Additional panel (direction)
regions.note: A small panel under a main sign that makes the direction clear, such as an arrow left or right. Go the way it shows.

regions.name: Additional panel (distance ahead)
regions.note: A small panel showing exactly how far ahead the restriction or hazard applies.

regions.name: Additional panel (extra detail)
regions.note: A small panel adding detail to the main sign above it, such as the time of day or the type of vehicle affected.

regions.name: Additional panel (road length)
regions.note: Shows how long a stretch of road the restriction or hazard covers. For example, '15m' means the next 15 metres.
